findings.title: Reuters reports one additional person killed in a strike near a school in Gaza City's Daraj neighborhood
findings.location: Daraj neighborhood, Gaza City, Gaza Strip, near an unidentified school
findings.affected_population_system: One person reported killed in an Israeli airstrike near a school; victim identity and civilian/combatant status not verified. findings.exact_supporting_passage: A third Palestinian was killed in an Israeli airstrike near a school in Gaza City's Daraj neighbourhood, health officials added.
findings.source_type: Established international news agency attributing death to Gaza health officials and separately reporting Israeli military acknowledgement of a strike in the area

bounded_discovery_context.prior_reuters_coverage_in_previous_heart: Earlier prior-run Reuters finding covered al-Zeitoun father and son and previously logged Khan Younis fatality, but did not identify Daraj casualty.

findings.title: Palestine Red Crescent discloses receiving only 1,618 tents since start of 2026 amid Gaza shelter and access shortfalls
findings.affected_population_system: Shelter provision for displaced households; PRCS's reported receipt of 1,618 tents during 2026 to date, versus widespread flood and emergency shelter needs. This is PRCS-specific cumulative supply, not a Gaza-wide tent-entry total or a newly occurring interdiction.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: For example, PRCS has only received 1618 of tents since the start of 2026 which does not meet the immense needs of displaced families.
findings.source_type: Primary humanitarian organization dated public statement (official two-page PDF)

bounded_discovery_context.novel_evidence: Specific 2026-to-date PRCS tent receipt count previously absent from verified immediately preceding watch heartbeat.
bounded_discovery_context.verification: PRCS own website lists statement as 10 Nov 2026; statement read and both PDF pages visually inspected. Count not independently audited.
bounded_discovery_context.uncertainty: Publication hour and underlying transaction dates unavailable; no discrete in-window supply disruption confirmed.
bounded_discovery_context.deduplication: Earlier OCHA storm casualty and flooding numbers repeated in PRCS statement were excluded; only PRCS-specific new quantified shelter capacity retained.
bounded_discovery_context.search_source: Direct PRCS newsroom check after targeted search #4

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall only. Primary daily Gaza collector and publisher remain authoritative.
